video_title: Jason Kidd: LeBron James Makes Philadelphia the Best Team in the East

quotes.speaker: Jason Kidd
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James joining Philadelphia makes them the best team in the East
quotes.excerpt: LeBron going to Philly automatically puts Philly in the talks of winning a championship.
quotes.quote: The one that is going to stand out and everyone is talking about is LeBron going to Philly. It automatically puts Philly in the talks of winning a championship. They could be the best team in the East, and that is just him at the age of 42. He still has that power, and so it is just a credit to him, but also to Philly because they do have a young backcourt that is very exciting to watch in Maxey and BJ. They are the team. That is the move.

quotes.speaker: Jason Kidd
quotes.summary_phrase: Giannis Antetokounmpo to Miami makes them a championship contender
quotes.excerpt: Giannis to Miami, and it also puts Miami in the talk of winning a championship.
quotes.quote: One B will be Giannis to Miami, and it also puts Miami in the talk of winning a championship.

quotes.speaker: Jason Kidd
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James and Nikola Jokic have the best court vision in the league
quotes.excerpt: My game is the closest to LeBron, even though his game is at a different altitude.
quotes.quote: I have talked about the Joker, but since you brought LeBron up, I would say LeBron's game is... my game is the closest to LeBron, even though his game is at a different altitude. He has the ability to make plays for his teammates. His IQ, understanding what is going to happen before it happens, is extremely high. Those are the two players when you talk about passing and just their basketball IQ.

quotes.speaker: Jason Kidd
quotes.summary_phrase: Cooper Flagg's potential and his path to becoming an NBA great
quotes.excerpt: He is on pace when you talk about LeBron and what he did as a young player.
quotes.quote: He is on pace when you talk about LeBron and what he did as a young player. Cooper's ability, he is one that loves to win, wants to win, likes to work, is not afraid of the moment. When you saw it at Duke taking a game-winning shot and missing, he is not afraid of the moment. So I would say he is on pace. Those are his comp. Now can he stay healthy like LeBron? And then, I think all greats are judged with championships, not so much stats, but that is the one stat that will stand out and hopefully Cooper can achieve that.

quotes.speaker: Jason Kidd
quotes.summary_phrase: Advice for Filipino players to overcome size disadvantages with grit
quotes.excerpt: Don't look at it as being undersized but being one that I can outlast you.
quotes.quote: Don't look at it as being undersized but being one that I can outlast you. There is a famous fighter here, Manny Pacquiao, who is grit and determination and being able to be the last one standing. You are going to be fatigued before I will. If I was a Filipino basketball player, I would say that I was going to work on all the small things, being able to be a good teammate, being one that wants to play defense, and so understanding that would be a standout and that one day you will be in the NBA because of that.
